verdict.rationale: Tavily ships an official Python SDK (pip install tavily-python, public GitHub repo, sync and async clients, project and session attribution, keyless mode). It covers search, extract, crawl, map, research, get_search_context and qna_search. It also ships an official JavaScript/TypeScript SDK (@tavily/core) with quick-start and reference docs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDKs, and documented JS SDK parity for map and research (the docs list only search, extract and crawl).
